info.description: Multi-brand EV inventory management API. All business endpoints live under /api/v1.
info.title: Maa Ambey Enterprises Inventory API

get.description: Every role, its grants (PROPOSED or APPROVED with approver and reference) and the permission catalogue. matrixStatus is PENDING_OWNER_SIGN_OFF while no grant is approved. Read-only; grants change only through the audited cmd/access tool. Requires access.roles.view.
The caller's newest uploads (up to 50) that are not linked to a business record yet and are still in the caller's location scope. Requires attachments.view.

post.description: multipart/form-data with one part named "file". The file is stored privately under a server-generated key; nothing about it is public. Optional locationId must be in the caller's location scope. The new attachment is not linked to a business record yet, so only the uploader can see it. Requires attachments.upload and X-CSRF-Token.

parameters.description: JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF up to maxBytes
parameters.name: file

415.description: UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE (type not allowed, or content does not match type/extension)

get.description: Maximum file size and accepted types (content is detected server-side; the declared type and the file-name extension must match it). Requires attachments.upload.
Requires attachments.view and access to this attachment (location scope; unlinked attachments: uploader only). Attachments the caller cannot see return 404, so their existence is not revealed.

Streams the file for a link from /attachments/{id}/link. Needs the same user's session; access is checked again, so a revoked permission stops downloads at once. Every download is audited. Served with nosniff, a sandboxing CSP and no caching.

After the same checks as metadata, returns a link that works only for the caller, only with their session, and only until expiresAt (ATTACHMENT_LINK_TTL, default 5 minutes). disposition=inline is allowed for images (preview); everything else downloads.

post.description: Verifies username and password and starts a server-side session. The session token is returned only in an HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict cookie (`__Host-maa_session` over HTTPS, `maa_session` in local development); the body carries the CSRF token for later mutations. Failures are generic: unknown user and wrong password both return INVALID_CREDENTIALS. ACCOUNT_DISABLED is only returned when the password was correct. Repeated failures return 429 with Retry-After.
Revokes the current session on the server and clears the cookie. Requires the session cookie and the X-CSRF-Token header.

get.description: Returns the signed-in user and a CSRF token. 401 UNAUTHENTICATED when no session cookie was sent; 401 SESSION_EXPIRED when the session ended (idle or absolute timeout, sign-out elsewhere, password change, account disabled) — the cookie is then cleared.
Brands are data. Includes pending and archived brands (BR-008); operational=true only for ACTIVE + AUTHORISED. Sorted by name. Requires catalogue.view.

post.description: Adds a brand as data. It starts PENDING_VERIFICATION / UNVERIFIED and is not usable for purchase/sales. Slug is derived from the name when omitted. Audited. Requires catalogue.manage and X-CSRF-Token.

get.description: Requires catalogue.view.

patch.description: Changes name and/or slug. Send the version you read; archived brands cannot be changed. Audited. Requires catalogue.manage and X-CSRF-Token.

post.description: Allowed only when every readiness check is met; otherwise 409 ACTIVATION_BLOCKED lists the unmet checks in details (field = check key) and the refused attempt is audited (outcome DENIED). Requires catalogue.brand.activate and X-CSRF-Token.
post.summary: Enable a brand for purchase and sales

get.description: Every prerequisite for enabling the brand for purchase/sales (BR-002) and whether it is met. approved_prices needs an approved SELLING price valid now for an active variant (C-04). Checks marked pending belong to features not built yet (supplier links, warranty terms, identifier rules) and are never met, so no brand can be activated until those exist. Requires catalogue.view.

post.description: Takes the brand out of use without deleting anything; its models, variants and history keep their references (BR-006, BR-008). Audited with the optional reason. Requires catalogue.archive and X-CSRF-Token.

put.description: Records the supplier/manufacturer legal identity, authorisation status, reference and evidence document (BR-002). AUTHORISED needs all three; the caller is recorded as verifier with the current time (UNVERIFIED clears both). Changing it on an ACTIVE brand takes it out of operation at once (operational=false). Archived brands cannot be changed. Audited. Requires catalogue.brand.authorise and X-CSRF-Token.

get.description: Sorted by name. brandId together with a variantId of another brand is a cross-brand mismatch: 422 (C-06). Requires catalogue.view.

post.description: Adds a pending colour to a variant that is not archived. The brand is taken from the variant; a brandId that differs is refused (422). Audited. Requires catalogue.manage and X-CSRF-Token.

get.description: Requires catalogue.view.

patch.description: Only PENDING_VERIFICATION colours can be edited. Editing a verified colour resets it to UNVERIFIED. Audited. Requires catalogue.manage and X-CSRF-Token.

post.description: A pending, verified colour of an ACTIVE variant becomes ACTIVE. Otherwise 409 ACTIVATION_BLOCKED, audited as DENIED. Requires catalogue.activate and X-CSRF-Token.
Never deletes. Audited. Requires catalogue.archive and X-CSRF-Token.
Same as model verification. Requires catalogue.verify and X-CSRF-Token.

get.description: Newest first. Search the GRN or PO number, supplier name or supplier reference; filter by status or purchase order. Requires goods_receipts.view.

post.description: Gets the next GRN number. The purchase order must be APPROVED or PARTIALLY_RECEIVED; the received date must not be in the future. Lines are entered with PUT. With Idempotency-Key, a repeat by the same user returns the first receipt with 200. Changes no stock. Requires goods_receipts.manage and X-CSRF-Token. Audited.

200.description: Replay of an earlier create with the same Idempotency-Key

get.description: The receipt with every line of its purchase order (ordered, posted, held by other drafts, available, received, accepted, rejected, over-receipt authorisation, units with identifiers, warnings), documents, history and the caller's actions. stockPosted is false for drafts: they change no stock. Requires goods_receipts.view.

put.description: Replaces the draft's received date, supplier reference, notes, lines and units with what is sent (all or nothing). Per line: received = accepted + rejected; units at most the received quantity (accepted/rejected units at most those quantities); identifiers optional, a chassis/frame number once per receipt and not on another open or posted receipt (409 DUPLICATE, details per unit). A line above what the PO line has left (ordered - posted - other drafts) needs overReceiptReason from a holder of goods_receipts.over_receipt (else 409 OVER_RECEIPT_REQUIRES_OVERRIDE, or 403 OVER_RECEIPT_NOT_AUTHORISED when the reason comes from someone without it, audited DENIED). Changes no stock. Requires goods_receipts.manage and X-CSRF-Token. Audited.

post.description: With a reason. The receipt, its lines and units stay as history and no longer hold purchase order quantity. Posted receipts are never cancelled. Requires goods_receipts.manage and X-CSRF-Token. Audited.

Links one of the caller's own uploads (POST /attachments) that is not attached to anything yet; it then belongs to the receipt for good. Downloads need attachments.view and goods_receipts.view. Drafts only. Requires goods_receipts.manage, attachments.upload and X-CSRF-Token. Audited.
post.summary: Attach a document to a draft goods receipt

post.description: Posts a DRAFT receipt in one database transaction (D-07): the receipt and its purchase order are locked; every line is re-checked against the PO as it is now (received <= ordered - posted unless an authorised over-receipt on the line covers it); every received unit must be captured (as many ACCEPTED and REJECTED units as the line's quantities); chassis/frame numbers must not be on another open or posted receipt or already registered (409 DUPLICATE or DUPLICATE_IDENTIFIER, field lines[i].units[j].chassisNumber in the receipt detail's order). Then each ACCEPTED unit becomes a vehicle unit at RECEIVED_PENDING_PDI at locationId (with its RECEIPT stock movement and audit), the PO lines' received quantities grow by the received quantity, the PO becomes PARTIALLY_RECEIVED or RECEIVED, the receipt becomes POSTED (immutable) and goods_receipt.posted is audited. Rejected units create no vehicle. Nothing becomes saleable: PDI follows. Any failure rolls everything back; nothing is half-posted. version must be the receipt's current version (409 VERSION_CONFLICT). locationId: an active location in the caller's scope (422 otherwise). Idempotency-Key is required: the same key and request by the same user returns the first posting with 200 and Idempotent-Replayed: true (concurrent repeats wait and replay); the same key with another request is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. A posted or cancelled receipt is 409 INVALID_STATE. Refusals for content or state are audited (DENIED). Requires goods_receipts.post and goods_receipts.view, and X-CSRF-Token.

409.description: VERSION_CONFLICT, INVALID_STATE, POSTING_BLOCKED (details: lines, lines[i].units, lines[i].receivedQuantity), DUPLICATE, DUPLICATE_IDENTIFIER or IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED

get.description: Confirms the API process is running. Does not check dependencies.

The permissions contract for the signed-in user. Permissions come only from owner-approved grants (plus proposed grants when RBAC_ALLOW_PROPOSED_GRANTS is on in local development). Empty until the permission matrix is approved. The UI uses this to decide what to show; every endpoint checks again.
get.summary: Current user's roles, permissions and location scope

get.description: Sorted by name. Requires catalogue.view.

parameters.description: Search name, internal or manufacturer code
parameters.name: q

post.description: Adds a PENDING_VERIFICATION / UNVERIFIED model to a brand that is not archived. internalCode is stored upper-case and is unique within the brand. Audited. Requires catalogue.manage and X-CSRF-Token.

get.description: Requires catalogue.view.

patch.description: Only PENDING_VERIFICATION models can be edited; the brand never changes (brandId is refused). Editing a verified model resets it to UNVERIFIED. Send null to clear manufacturerCode or vehicleType. Audited. Requires catalogue.manage and X-CSRF-Token.

post.description: A pending, verified model of a brand that is not archived becomes ACTIVE. Otherwise 409 ACTIVATION_BLOCKED (details: verification, parent), audited as DENIED. Requires catalogue.activate and X-CSRF-Token.
Never deletes; variants and history keep their references. Audited. Requires catalogue.archive and X-CSRF-Token.
Records source (URL and/or private document), source date and confidence for a pending model; the caller is the verifier. Audited. Requires catalogue.verify and X-CSRF-Token.

get.description: The caller's batches, newest first (every batch for a caller with every location). Requires stock.import.preview.

post.description: Stores the CSV privately and validates it: the file (UTF-8 text, .csv, template marker and version, header with every required column, no duplicate or unknown column, at least one and at most maxRows data rows) and every row (required values, lengths, catalogue brand → model → variant → colour resolved exactly — never guessed —, brand/model/variant/colour verification and activation, location known, active and in the caller's scope, stock status, received date not after the business date, cost format, supplier, chassis/frame duplicates within the file, against vehicle units and against open receipt drafts, and motor/battery/charger possible duplicates as warnings while their uniqueness is unapproved). Row status: ERROR (cannot be imported as is), BLOCKED_UNVERIFIED_MAPPING (maps to a catalogue entry that is not verified/active), WARNING (importable, review), VALID. A file that cannot be read as the template is stored as a REJECTED batch with fileIssues and no rows. THE PREVIEW CREATES NO STOCK: no vehicle unit, receipt, movement, balance or catalogue change; only the batch, its rows, the file's private attachment and audit events are written. Idempotency-Key is required: the same key with the same file returns the first batch (200, Idempotent-Replayed: true); with another file 409. Requires stock.import.preview and X-CSRF-Token.
post.summary: Upload an opening stock file for preview

get.description: The template version, accepted format (CSV UTF-8 only; XLSX is refused), size/row limits, preview lifetime, every column (name, required, max length, format, meaning) and the accepted stock statuses, plus the business date dates are checked against. Requires stock.import.preview.
A CSV file with the template marker line (#template:OS-IMPORT-1) and the column header line, and no data rows. Requires stock.import.preview.

The batch: file reference (attachment ID, name, SHA-256, size), uploader, upload time, template version, business date, expiry (expired: history only, G-07 must refuse it), status, summary counts and file issues. commitAvailable is always false: committing is the separate G-07 workflow. Another user's batch is 404 unless the caller has every location. Requires stock.import.preview.
get.summary: Get an opening stock import preview

post.description: Records, once, that the batch was reconciled to a signed physical count: physicalCountReference (1-100 characters) and physicalCountDate (not after today), mappingsReviewed and duplicatesReviewed (both must be true) and receivedDatesApproved (whether the file's received dates are the agreed opening-stock dates; false leaves the units' stock age MISSING_ORIGIN in E-07). Only a non-expired PREVIEWED batch in OS-IMPORT-1 whose every line is VALID can be approved; every line's location must be in the caller's scope. The same approval repeated by its approver returns 200 (Idempotent-Replayed: true); any other approval of an approved batch is 409. Approvals are never changed or deleted. Requires stock.import.approve (granted to no role until the owner signs off) and X-CSRF-Token. Creates no stock.
post.summary: Approve an opening stock import batch (G-07)

403.description: FORBIDDEN (permission, or a line's location outside the caller's scope) or CSRF_FAILED

409.description: INVALID_STATE (rejected/other template, or not every line VALID), IMPORT_PREVIEW_EXPIRED, IMPORT_ALREADY_APPROVED or IMPORT_ALREADY_COMMITTED

422.description: VALIDATION_FAILED (physicalCountReference, physicalCountDate, mappingsReviewed, duplicatesReviewed, receivedDatesApproved, note)

get.description: The commit of a committed batch: commit ID and OSC reference, batch, COMMITTED status, units created (line, vehicle unit, unit number, status, OPENING_BALANCE movement), committer, time, approval and file fingerprint. 404 until the batch is committed. Requires stock.import.preview, stock.import.approve or stock.import.commit.
get.summary: Get an opening stock import batch's commit (G-07)

post.description: Turns the batch into stock exactly once, all lines or none. Never trusts the preview: the stored file is read again (SHA-256, size, template version, same lines and values as staged) and, in one transaction with the batch locked and the catalogue/locations/suppliers share-locked, every line is re-validated against the current database (catalogue verification and activation, location active and in the caller's scope, chassis/frame duplicates against vehicle units, receipt drafts and the file, stock status approved for opening stock, positive cost, same resolution as the approved preview). Warnings are not accepted (no approved rule, OQ-49). Any refused line → 422 IMPORT_ROWS_BLOCKED (details: rows[line].field — CODE (SEVERITY): message) and nothing is written. On success each line becomes a vehicle unit (source OPENING_STOCK, linked to its batch line; no supplier/PO/GRN history is invented), with a REGISTERED history entry, an OPENING_BALANCE stock movement (none → its status, 0 → 1, at its location, source = the batch) and audit events. Idempotency-Key is required: the same key from the same user returns the commit again (200, Idempotent-Replayed: true, replayed: true); the same key for another batch is 409. A batch committed by anyone else is 409 IMPORT_ALREADY_COMMITTED. Requires stock.import.commit (separate from preview and approval; granted to no role until the owner signs off) and X-CSRF-Token.
post.summary: Commit an approved opening stock import batch (G-07)

403.description: FORBIDDEN (permission, or a line's location outside the caller's scope) or CSRF_FAILED

409.description: IMPORT_APPROVAL_REQUIRED, IMPORT_ALREADY_COMMITTED, IMPORT_PREVIEW_EXPIRED, OPENING_STATUSES_NOT_APPROVED, IMPORT_SOURCE_INVALID, INVALID_STATE, DUPLICATE_IDENTIFIER (registered concurrently) or IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED

422.description: IMPORT_ROWS_BLOCKED (details per line and field) or VALIDATION_FAILED (Idempotency-Key)

get.description: Staged rows in file order (rowNumber = line in the uploaded file): the values exactly as uploaded (source), the normalised values and resolved references G-07 will use (normalised, null when invalid), a display snapshot of the resolution (resolved) and every issue (field, code, severity, message, suggestion). Filters: status, duplicate=true (any duplicate identifier issue), unresolved=true (any catalogue/location mapping issue). Requires stock.import.preview.
get.summary: Rows of an opening stock import preview

parameters.description: Only rows with a duplicate identifier issue
parameters.name: duplicate

parameters.description: Only rows with an unresolved catalogue or location mapping
parameters.name: unresolved

get.description: The configurable PDI checklist (no item is seeded: an empty list means it is not configured). Active items first, by sortOrder then code. brandId lists the items that apply to that brand (every-brand items and the brand's own). Requires vehicle_units.view, vehicle_units.pdi.record or vehicle_units.pdi.checklist.manage.

parameters.description: Brand ID: items that apply to this brand
parameters.name: brandId

post.description: Adds an ACTIVE item for every brand (no brandId) or for one brand. code (2-40 of A-Z, 0-9, _; upper-cased) is unique among active items of the same brand scope (409 DUPLICATE). Items are never edited or deleted: retire one and create another, so recorded outcomes keep their meaning. Mandatory inspection criteria are the client's to define; nothing is pre-filled. Requires vehicle_units.pdi.checklist.manage and X-CSRF-Token. Audited (pdi_checklist_item.created).

ACTIVE -> RETIRED with a reason (1-500). A retired item no longer applies to new inspections; recorded outcomes keep it. version must be the item's current version. Requires vehicle_units.pdi.checklist.manage and X-CSRF-Token. Audited (pdi_checklist_item.retired).

get.description: One inspection with its outcomes (checklist code and label, PASS/FAIL, note) and evidence (attachment ID, name, type, size; download through the attachments API). evidence is empty and evidenceHidden true without attachments.view. An inspection of a unit outside the caller's scope is 404. Requires vehicle_units.view.

Drafts, approved and cancelled prices, newest effective date first. Only price types the caller may see are returned (COST needs catalogue.cost_price.view); asking for another type is 403. brandId, priceListId and variantId of different brands are a cross-brand mismatch: 422 (C-06).

post.description: Drafts a price for a variant on a price list of the same brand (brand and model come from the variant). SELLING needs catalogue.price.manage, COST catalogue.cost_price.edit. taxConfigurationId must be empty until an approved tax configuration exists. supersedesId names the approved price this one replaces from its effectiveFrom. Requires X-CSRF-Token. Audited.

get.description: A price of a type the caller may not see is reported as 404.

patch.description: Only drafts change; approved prices are superseded instead. Requires the edit permission of its type and X-CSRF-Token. Audited.

post.description: Requires catalogue.price.approve (plus view of its type); never the drafter (403 SELF_APPROVAL_NOT_ALLOWED). The price must not start in the past (no retroactive change), its list, brand, model and variant must not be archived and the variant must be verified (409 APPROVAL_BLOCKED). It may not overlap another approved price of the same list/variant/type (409 PRICE_OVERLAP) unless it supersedes it: then the superseded price ends at this price's start. Approved prices never change again. Refusals are audited as DENIED. Requires X-CSRF-Token.
The draft is kept as cancelled history. Requires the edit permission of its type and X-CSRF-Token. Audited.

get.description: Requires catalogue.price.view or catalogue.cost_price.view.

post.description: A named list of prices for one brand (amounts in INR). Requires catalogue.price.manage or catalogue.cost_price.edit and X-CSRF-Token. Audited.

409.description: DUPLICATE (name in brand) or INVALID_STATE (archived brand)

get.description: Requires catalogue.price.view or catalogue.cost_price.view.

patch.description: Requires catalogue.price.manage or catalogue.cost_price.edit and X-CSRF-Token. Audited.

post.description: No new prices can be drafted or approved on it; its approved history stays readable and lookups still answer for past instants. Requires catalogue.price.manage or catalogue.cost_price.edit and X-CSRF-Token. Audited.

get.description: The approved price of the variant and type on the list that is valid at `at` (default now). Quotations store this answer as a snapshot (SAL-003); later approvals never change the answer for a past instant. 404 PRICE_NOT_FOUND when none is valid; a variant of another brand than the list (or an unknown list/variant) is 422 (C-06). COST needs catalogue.cost_price.view.
approvalThreshold null means none is configured and every PO needs an approver. Requires purchase_orders.view or purchase_orders.settings.manage.
get.summary: Get the purchase order approval settings

put.description: A threshold needs the owner's sign-off reference. POs already submitted keep the threshold they were submitted under. Requires purchase_orders.settings.manage and X-CSRF-Token. Audited.
put.summary: Change the purchase order approval settings

get.description: Newest first. Search the PO number or supplier name; filter by status, supplier or brand (a line of that brand). Totals and remaining quantities are computed by the server. Requires purchase_orders.view.

post.description: Gets the next PO number. The supplier must exist and not be archived; each line's brand, model and variant must belong together and not be archived. A line's priceListId (needs catalogue.cost_price.view) snapshots that list's approved COST price valid now. With Idempotency-Key, a repeat by the same user returns the first PO with 200. Requires purchase_orders.manage and X-CSRF-Token. Audited.

200.description: Replay of an earlier create with the same Idempotency-Key

get.description: The PO with lines (agreed costs, received and remaining quantities, warnings), status history, unmet prerequisites for the next step and the caller's possible actions. Catalogue cost snapshots need catalogue.cost_price.view. Requires purchase_orders.view.

patch.description: Supplier, expected date (YYYY-MM-DD) or notes; null clears the date or notes. Drafts only. Requires purchase_orders.manage and X-CSRF-Token. Audited.

post.description: Never by the PO's creator or submitter (403 SELF_APPROVAL_NOT_ALLOWED). The submission prerequisites are checked again. Refusals are audited as DENIED. Requires purchase_orders.approve and X-CSRF-Token. Audited.
Drafts, submitted POs and approved POs with nothing received. The PO stays as history. Requires purchase_orders.cancel and X-CSRF-Token. Audited.

One line per variant. Brand, model and variant must belong together and not be archived. priceListId (needs catalogue.cost_price.view) snapshots the approved COST price valid now. version is the PO's. Requires purchase_orders.manage and X-CSRF-Token. Audited.
post.summary: Add a line to a draft

patch.description: Quantity, unit cost or note. Sending priceListId takes a fresh cost snapshot; null removes it; leaving it out keeps the snapshot as it was. version is the PO's. Requires purchase_orders.manage and X-CSRF-Token. Audited.

post.description: Only lines of a draft are removed; submitted POs keep their lines. version is the PO's. Requires purchase_orders.manage and X-CSRF-Token. Audited.
With a reason, recorded in the status history. Requires purchase_orders.approve and X-CSRF-Token. Audited.
post.summary: Return a submitted purchase order to draft

post.description: Needs at least one line, an expected date not in the past, a VERIFIED supplier with a current verified relationship to every line's brand, and each brand (active and authorised), model and variant active. Without a signed-off threshold every PO then waits for approval (SUBMITTED); within a signed-off threshold it is APPROVED with basis BELOW_THRESHOLD. Requires purchase_orders.manage and X-CSRF-Token. Audited.

409.description: SUBMISSION_BLOCKED (details: unmet keys), VERSION_CONFLICT or INVALID_STATE

get.description: Reports whether PostgreSQL is reachable ("database") and migrated to the schema version this build expects with no failed migration ("migrations"). Returns 503 when not ready. The API never migrates on its own.
APPROVED and PARTIALLY_RECEIVED purchase orders with ordered, posted, draft-held and available quantities. Search the PO number or supplier name. Requires goods_receipts.manage.
get.summary: List purchase orders open for receipts

post.description: Records a new configuration version (status PROPOSED) after expectedVersion (409 VERSION_CONFLICT otherwise). Bands: 1-20, keys unique (1-32 lower-case letters, digits, - or _), labels 1-60 characters, whole days 0-36500; the first starts at 0, each starts the day after the previous one ends (no gap or overlap), only the last has no maxDays (open-ended). source names the document or decision the thresholds come from. Earlier versions are kept unchanged and no stock record is rewritten (ages and bands are calculated on read). Audited (stock_ageing.bands_proposed). Requires stock.ageing.configure and X-CSRF-Token.

Approves the current version while it is PROPOSED (409 INVALID_STATE otherwise). The person who proposed it cannot approve it (403 SELF_APPROVAL_NOT_ALLOWED, audited DENIED); the migration's LED-008 proposal can be approved by any holder of the permission. Only the approval fields change. Audited (stock_ageing.bands_approved). Requires stock.ageing.configure and X-CSRF-Token.
post.summary: Approve the proposed ageing band configuration

get.description: The current ageing band configuration (latest version, PROPOSED until approved), the business time zone and today's business date ages are counted to, and the boundary rule: a band covers minDays <= age <= maxDays in whole days (both inclusive), the last band is open-ended, age = business date - origin date. configured is false (bandSet null) when no configuration exists; ages are then still calculated, without bands. Read-only. Requires vehicle_units.view or stock.ageing.configure.

Counts (adjustment requests) at the locations in the caller's scope, newest first, without lines. status=SUBMITTED is the approval queue. Filters: status, locationId (must be in scope). Requires stock.adjustment.view.

post.description: Creates a DRAFT count (number SC-000001…) at an active location in the caller's scope. Changes no stock. Idempotency-Key is required: the same key and body by the same user returns the first count with 200 and Idempotent-Replayed: true; the same key with another body is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. Requires stock.adjustment.create and X-CSRF-Token. Audited (stock_count.created).

get.description: The count with its lines: expected quantity/status (read from the ledger when the line was recorded), observed, server-computed variance, reason, who recorded it, stockChanged (the balance or unit moved since; undecided counts only), outcome and the posted movement. A count at a location outside the caller's scope is 404. Requires stock.adjustment.view.

post.description: SUBMITTED -> APPROVED in one transaction: every line is locked and re-checked against the ledger (409 STOCK_CHANGED_SINCE_COUNT if stock moved: nothing is posted; reject it and recount), each parts line with a variance posts one COUNT_ADJUSTMENT movement from the expected to the observed quantity (the balance follows; audit stock_item.adjusted), vehicle discrepancies are recorded only (no movement: no approved correction exists), and the decision is audited (stock_count.approved). Never by anyone who created, counted or submitted it (403 SELF_APPROVAL_NOT_ALLOWED, audited DENIED). Idempotency-Key is required: the same approver, key and body returns the approved count with 200 and Idempotent-Replayed: true and posts nothing again; any other decided count is 409 INVALID_STATE. Requires stock.adjustment.approve and X-CSRF-Token.
post.summary: Approve a stock count and post its adjustments

parameters.description: Current version and an optional note
parameters.name: body

409.description: VERSION_CONFLICT, INVALID_STATE (not submitted; archived SKU), STOCK_CHANGED_SINCE_COUNT or IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED

post.description: Records (or re-records) one line on a DRAFT count: stockItemId + observedQuantity (>= 0, up to 3 decimals) + uom (the SKU's unit; ACTIVE, QUANTITY-tracked SKUs only — SERIAL is 409 TRACKING_NOT_SUPPORTED), or vehicleUnitId (a unit recorded at the count's location) + found. The server reads the expected quantity/status from the ledger now and computes the variance; reason is required when it is not zero. Changes no stock. version must be the count's current version. Requires stock.adjustment.create and X-CSRF-Token. Audited (stock_count.line_recorded).

409.description: VERSION_CONFLICT, INVALID_STATE (not a draft; archived SKU) or TRACKING_NOT_SUPPORTED

422.description: VALIDATION_FAILED (version, stockItemId, vehicleUnitId, observedQuantity, uom, found, reason)

post.description: SUBMITTED -> REJECTED with a required reason. Posts nothing; stock is unchanged. Same separation of duties, idempotency and replay rules as approval. Requires stock.adjustment.approve and X-CSRF-Token. Audited (stock_count.rejected).

DRAFT -> SUBMITTED. Needs at least one line, and every line must still match the ledger (otherwise 409 STOCK_CHANGED_SINCE_COUNT naming the lines: re-record them). Changes no stock. Every submitted count needs an approver who took no part in it (no approval threshold is configured). Requires stock.adjustment.create and X-CSRF-Token. Audited (stock_count.submitted).
post.summary: Submit a stock count for approval

409.description: VERSION_CONFLICT, INVALID_STATE (not a draft, no lines) or STOCK_CHANGED_SINCE_COUNT

get.description: The same entry as in the timeline, with the same visibility and shaping. An unknown or malformed ID, a movement of an item type the caller may not view, or one outside the caller's location scope is 404 (its existence is not revealed). Read-only. Requires vehicle_units.view or stock.parts.view.

Runs the read-only ledger reconciliation now and returns its summary and one page of discrepancies. Vehicle units are compared with their stock movements: no movement (VEHICLE_NO_MOVEMENTS), history not starting with the RECEIPT (VEHICLE_MISSING_RECEIPT), a later RECEIPT (VEHICLE_REPEATED_RECEIPT), status or location different from the latest movement (VEHICLE_STATUS_MISMATCH, VEHICLE_LOCATION_MISMATCH), latest movement not leaving the unit held (VEHICLE_NOT_HELD), a movement not starting where the previous one ended (VEHICLE_BROKEN_CHAIN). Parts balances per SKU and location: balance different from the quantity after the latest movement, 0 without one (PARTS_BALANCE_MISMATCH), movements without a balance record (PARTS_BALANCE_MISSING), a balance below zero (PARTS_NEGATIVE_BALANCE), a movement not starting from the quantity the previous one left, the first from 0 (PARTS_BROKEN_CHAIN). HIGH: the record disagrees with the ledger or its origin is missing; MEDIUM: the history is inconsistent while the record matches its latest movement. Every query runs in one read-only, repeatable-read transaction: the result is one consistent snapshot and nothing is written, corrected or stored (runs are logged on the server under runId only). The summary counts the whole run; itemType, type, severity and locationId (in scope) filter the returned items, ordered by severity, type and reference; reference is stable across runs. Rows are what the caller may see: vehicle units need vehicle_units.view and a current location in scope (or none yet); parts balances need stock.parts.view at a location in scope; a location outside the scope is named by ID only. No cost is returned. Requires stock.reconciliation.view and vehicle_units.view or stock.parts.view.

Filters combine (AND). receivedFrom/receivedTo are inclusive dates; Stock ageing (E-07, ADR-029): every unit carries ageing (origin date and source GRN — the posted goods receipt's received date —, age in whole days to the business date in the business time zone, band of the current configuration, or MISSING_ORIGIN with a reason and no age/band); ageDays is ageing.ageDays and null without a reliable origin. minAgeDays/maxAgeDays are inclusive whole days and ageingBand a band key (minDays <= age <= maxDays); all three select only units with a reliable origin. originStatus=KNOWN|MISSING selects by origin reliability. An unknown ageingBand, or ageingBand/minAgeDays/maxAgeDays with originStatus=MISSING, is 422. Colour is not filterable: units carry no colour (not captured on receipt). Every sort ends with the unit ID, so pages are stable. saleable=true lists only AVAILABLE units: units pending PDI, on QUALITY_HOLD or SERVICE_HOLD, REJECTED, on DISPLAY, RESERVED, SOLD or DELIVERED are never saleable stock (INV-006/007, PO-006). Only units without a location or at a location in the caller's scope are listed; a locationId outside the scope is refused. unitCost and costCurrency are null, and costHidden true, without vehicle_units.cost.view. Requires vehicle_units.view.

Files open through GET /attachments/{id}/link or /content; no storage key or URL is returned. Without attachments.view documents is empty and documentsHidden true. Later status changes are its stock movements (GET /vehicle-units/{id}/stock-movements). The referenced records open through their own APIs and permissions. A unit at a location outside the caller's scope is 404. unitCost and costCurrency are null, and costHidden true, without vehicle_units.cost.view. Requires vehicle_units.view.

The unit as it is now (status, version, saleable), the dispositions its status admits (PASS and HOLD while RECEIVED_PENDING_PDI; REJECT while QUALITY_HOLD; none otherwise — OQ-31), canRecord (the caller holds vehicle_units.pdi.record), the active checklist that applies to the unit (empty = not configured: PASS is refused) and its inspections, newest first. A unit at a location outside the caller's scope is 404. Requires vehicle_units.view.

post.description: Records one complete inspection and applies its disposition in one transaction: the stock movement (PDI_PASS, QUALITY_HOLD or REJECT; source PDI_INSPECTION with the inspection number), the unit's new status and version, the inspection with its outcomes, the evidence links and the audit events (pdi_inspection.recorded, vehicle_unit.moved) commit together or not at all. The actor is the session user and the time the database clock. Rules: version must be the unit's current version (409 VERSION_CONFLICT). PASS: RECEIVED_PENDING_PDI -> AVAILABLE; needs at least one applicable checklist item (409 PDI_CHECKLIST_NOT_CONFIGURED) and every outcome PASS. HOLD: RECEIVED_PENDING_PDI -> QUALITY_HOLD. REJECT: QUALITY_HOLD -> REJECTED only. A direct reject of a unit awaiting PDI and any release from hold are refused (409 INVALID_STATE, OQ-31). items must hold exactly one outcome for every active checklist item that applies to the unit (none missing, none unknown/retired/other brand); a FAIL needs a note. HOLD and REJECT need notes and at least one evidence attachment (INV-008). attachmentIds must be the caller's own unlinked uploads (POST /attachments) at the unit's location; they become private PDI evidence (attachments.view + vehicle_units.view to open). A unit without a chassis/frame number cannot leave RECEIVED_PENDING_PDI (409 INVALID_STATE, INV-002). Idempotency-Key is required: the same key and request by the same user returns the first inspection with 200 and Idempotent-Replayed: true (nothing written again; concurrent repeats wait and replay); the same key with another request is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. Refusals for the unit's status, a missing checklist or a missing chassis number are audited (DENIED). Unknown fields (status, actorId, inspectedAt, result, ...) are 422. A unit outside the caller's scope is 404. Requires vehicle_units.pdi.record and X-CSRF-Token.

fromLocationId.description: Locations as recorded; code/name are null for a location outside the caller's scope.

fromStatus.description: Statuses: VEHICLE_UNIT rows only (fromStatus null on a receipt); null on STOCK_ITEM rows.

quantityBefore.description: Quantities before and after (decimal strings: 0 -> 1 for a vehicle receipt, 1 -> 1 after); uom on STOCK_ITEM rows.

sourceHidden.description:
SourceHidden: the movement has a source record the caller may not open (permission-derived);
its reason and note are then null too.

sourceId.description: SourceID/SourceReference: null when the source has none, or when sourceHidden is true.

stockItem.description: STOCK_ITEM rows: the SKU; null on VEHICLE_UNIT rows.

supplierId.description: SupplierID/SupplierName: PARTS_RECEIPT rows; null without suppliers.view.

vehicleUnit.description: VEHICLE_UNIT rows: the unit; null on STOCK_ITEM rows.

asOf.description: AsOf/TimeZone: the business date ages are counted to.

bands.description: Bands: every band of the configuration, in order, with its count (0 included); empty when not configured.

configured.description: Configured: a band configuration exists; BandSet identifies it (null when not configured).

unbanded.description: Unbanded: units with an age but no band (only when no configuration exists).

ageDays.description:
AgeDays is the stock age in whole days from the approved origin date to the
business date (E-07, ADR-029) — the same value as ageing.ageDays; null when the
unit has no reliable origin date (never a fabricated age).

ageing.description:
Ageing is the unit's stock ageing (E-07): origin date and source, age, band, or
why no reliable origin date exists. Calculated by the server on every read.

unitCost.description: UnitCost is the acquisition cost (excluding tax); null without vehicle_units.cost.view.

documents.description: Documents the caller may open; empty without attachments.view, and then documentsHidden is true.

openingStockBatchId.description: Opening stock (G-07): the import batch, its OSI reference and the file line the unit came from.

previewable.description: Image types can be previewed inline; others are always downloaded.
